ElevenLabs Inc. is a software company that specializes in developing natural-sounding speech synthesis software using deep learning . It was founded in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski . [ 3 ] ElevenLabs is legally incorporated in the US. [ 4 ] It is based in London and also has offices in New York City , Warsaw and San Francisco . [ 5 ]

## Name etymology
The name ElevenLabs derives from the English word eleven . The number refers to November 11, the date of Poland’s National Independence Day (the eleventh day of the eleventh month). [ 6 ] The element Labs refers to the English word laboratories and indicates the company’s research and development profile.

## History
ElevenLabs was co-founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski , an ex- Google machine learning engineer and Mati Staniszewski , an ex- Palantir deployment strategist. [ 7 ] Both were raised in Poland , and their inspiration for founding ElevenLabs reportedly came from watching inadequately dubbed American films. [ 8 ] [ 9 ]
Dąbkowski and Staniszewski initially considered different funding options, including the possibility of collaborating with a startup accelerator. In January 2023 they revealed having secured a $2 million pre-seed round. The startup's specialization in AI voice intelligence, a still-emerging field in Europe , played a significant role in attracting investors. The pre-seed funding was primarily led by Credo Ventures , and joined by Concept Ventures. [ 10 ]
In January 2023, ElevenLabs publicly released its beta platform . [ 11 ]
In June 2023, ElevenLabs raised a $19 million Series A funding round at a valuation of about $100 million. [ 12 ] [ 13 ] [ 9 ] The funding round was co-led by the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz , former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman , and entrepreneur Daniel Gross . It also saw participation from prominent individuals such as SV Angel , Mike Krieger (co-founder of Instagram), Brendan Iribe (co-founder of Oculus ), Mustafa Suleyman (co-founder of Deepmind ), and Tim O'Reilly (founder of O'Reilly Media ). It was also announced that Andreessen Horowitz would be joining ElevenLabs' board. [ 8 ]
On January 22, 2024, ElevenLabs raised an additional $80 million in Series B funding raising the total valuation of the company to $1.1 billion. The funding round was led by Andreessen Horowitz , Friedman , Gross, and Sequoia Capital . Additionally, the company announced a series of new products, including their Voice Marketplace, AI Dubbing Studio, and mobile app. [ 14 ]
In the lead-up to the January 2024 New Hampshire Democratic primary , AI-generated robocalls purportedly from Joe Biden encouraging voters to skip voting on the day of the primary were sent to thousands of residents. The New Hampshire attorney general's office launched an investigation into the incident and linked it to a company based in Texas, with audio experts concluding the call was made using ElevenLabs. In response to the incident, CEO Mati Staniszewski stated that the company was “dedicated to preventing the misuse of audio AI tools” but provided no comment on specific incidents. [ 15 ]
On January 30, 2025, ElevenLabs announced their $180 million Series C funding raising the total valuation of the company to $3.3 billion. The round was co-led by a16z and ICONIQ Growth with additional new investors NEA, World Innovation Lab (WiL), Valor, Endeavor Catalyst Fund and Lunate and brought on strategic investors including Deutsche Telekom, LG Technology Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, NTT Docomo Ventures, and RingCentral Ventures. [ 16 ]
In September 2025, ElevenLabs opened an employee tender offer , allowing staff who had worked at the company for at least a year to sell shares at a $6.6 billion valuation. [ 17 ] It completed another tender offer for staff at a $22B valuation in September 2026. [ 18 ]
On February 4, 2026, ElevenLabs announced that it raised $500 million at an $11 billion valuation, as it eyes a potential IPO . [ 19 ]
In March 2026, ElevenLabs pledged to committing $1 billion in free restoration voice technology to 1 million people living with permanent voice loss. [ 20 ]

## Products
ElevenLabs is primarily known for its browser-based , AI-assisted text-to-speech software, Speech Synthesis, which can produce lifelike speech by synthesizing vocal emotion and intonation , and now Conversational AI, a developer platform for launching interactive voice agents. [ 21 ] The company states that its models are trained to interpret the context in the text, and adjust the intonation and pacing accordingly. [ 22 ] It uses advanced algorithms to analyze the contextual aspects of text, aiming to detect emotions like anger, sadness, happiness, or alarm, which enables the system to understand the user's sentiment, [ 23 ] resulting in achieving a more realistic and human-like inflection. The startup is in the process of patenting this technology. [ 10 ] On its beta site, users can submit text and generate audio files from a selection of default voices. Paying users are given the ability to upload custom voice samples to create new vocal styles using the company's voice cloning tool. [ 24 ]

## Voice Library
Voice Library is the company's feature for sharing unique voice profiles created using their Voice Design technology. These pre-designed voice profiles allow users to select a voice that best suits their needs, rather than creating one from scratch. [ 25 ] There are now more than 1,000 community-created voices in the library. Another tool called VoiceLab allows users to clone voices from just a few short snippets of audio and can create entirely new synthetic voices. [ 8 ]

## AI Speech Classifier
On June 20, 2023, ElevenLabs released an AI recognition tool called the AI Speech Classifier, which it claims is the first of its kind. [ 8 ] The tool is accessible through an API and designed to determine if an uploaded audio sample originates from ElevenLabs' proprietary AI technology. [ 9 ] The company has expressed its intention to collaborate with other AI developers in creating a universal detection system that could be adopted industry-wide. [ 26 ]

## Projects
In July 2023, ElevenLabs announced "Projects", a tool for creating long-form spoken content such as audiobooks and dialogue segments with contextually-aware synthetic or custom voices. [ 9 ] [ 27 ] The tool was released in September. In August, ElevenLabs expanded its voice generation capabilities to 28 languages. Using an in-house AI model, it automatically detects languages like Korean , Dutch , and Vietnamese , allowing for "emotionally rich" multilingual speech generation. The company also announced that its technology had officially exited its beta phase . [ 28 ] [ 29 ]

## ElevenReader
In August 2024, ElevenLabs released ElevenReader, an app that converts textual content (such as PDFs, eBooks or articles) to audio. The app was made available on iOS, Android, and the web. [ 30 ]

## AI Dubbing and voice products
In October 2023, ElevenLabs presented "AI Dubbing", a tool that is able to translate speech into more than 20 languages. The feature is capable of preserving the speaker's original voice, emotions, and intonation, by employing proprietary methods to handle tasks like noise removal, speaker differentiation, transcription, and synchronization of translated speech with the original audio. [ 31 ]
In May 2024, ElevenLabs shared samples from their text-to-music model, which became available for public use in July 2025. [ 32 ] In June 2024, ElevenLabs released the ElevenLabs Reader App on iOS and Android which allows users to listen to articles, PDFs, and ePubs with AI Voices on their phone. In July 2024, ElevenLabs released "Voice Isolator" which removes background noise from audio. [ 33 ] In November 2024, they released Conversational AI, a developer platform for launching interactive voice agents. [ 34 ] In February 2025, the company introduced a new platform that enables authors to create and publish AI-generated audiobooks directly on its Reader app. [ 35 ] Later that month, the company released Scribe, a speech-to-text model that transcribes audio with character-level timestamps and speaker diarization [ 36 ] with industry-leading word error rate according to internal benchmarks and third party tests from Artificial Analysis. [ 37 ]
In June 2025, ElevenLabs released Eleven v3, a new text-to-speech model that supports more than 70 languages, natural multi-speaker dialogue, and audio tags like [excited], [whispers], and [sighs]. [ 38 ]

## Eleven Music
In August 2025, ElevenLabs launched Eleven Music, an AI music generator that enables users to generate studio-grade music from natural language prompts. [ 39 ] The platform was developed in collaboration with record labels, publishers, and artists, and is cleared for commercial use across various applications including film, television, podcasts, social media videos, advertisements, and gaming. Eleven Music provides control over genre, style, and structure, allowing users to create tracks with or without vocals in multiple languages including English, Spanish, German, and Japanese. The platform features advanced editing capabilities that enable users to modify individual sections of songs or entire compositions. Built with a proprietary AI music model developed by ElevenLabs, the system can generate real-time music with seamless genre and instrument blending while closely following complex, multi-layered prompts for lyrics, key, and tempo specifications. [ 40 ]

## ElevenAgents
In February 2026, ElevenLabs released Expressive Mode in ElevenAgents. Expressive Mode combines two updates: Eleven v3 Conversational - a new emotionally intelligent, context-aware text-to-speech model, built on Eleven v3 and optimized for real-time dialogue and a new turn-taking system for better-timed responses with fewer interruptions. [ 41 ]

## Reception
Following its launch in January 2023, ElevenLabs gained rapid momentum and was commended for its voice output quality, fast generation times, and a "generous free tier". It has also been praised for its ability to accurately pronounce names with unique or uncommon pronunciations, addressing a common shortcoming in similar tools that often cater primarily to Western names. [ 42 ] The company reached over one million registered users between its launch and June 2023. [ 8 ] [ 9 ] [ 43 ]
In April 2025, ElevenLabs was featured in the Forbes AI 50 list. [ 44 ]
ElevenLabs was criticized after users were able to abuse its software to generate controversial statements in the vocal style of celebrities, public officials, and other famous individuals, [ 45 ] [ 46 ] [ 47 ] particularly attracting attention after users on 4chan used the tool to share hateful messages. [ 48 ] [ 49 ] [ 26 ]

## Culture
ElevenLabs’ culture includes involvement in media and creative projects alongside its core technology development. [ 50 ] The company released the album The Next , a project built around AI-generated vocals, which involved collaborations with artists, producers, and developers working with synthetic voice tools. The album contains songs with varying levels of AI and human input, and the earnings from its streams go back to all participating artists. [ 51 ]
In addition to music, ElevenLabs produced the documentary series 11 Voices , which premiered at SXSW in 2026 [ 52 ] and features interviews with individuals working across artificial intelligence, audio production, and related fields, addressing topics such as voice synthesis, ethics, and creative practice. [ 53 ] [ 54 ]

TITLE: What Is ElevenLabs? The AI Voice Platform, Explained | Built In

Artificial intelligence can now generate speech that could easily be confused with a human voice. ElevenLabs is at the forefront of developing generative AI models that can speak with natural-sounding pauses, emotional inflection and distinctive accents.

## What Is ElevenLabs?
ElevenLabs is an AI audio platform that generates realistic speech, clones authorized voices, translates and transcribes audio and creates music and sound effects. Creators use it for videos, podcasts and audiobooks, and businesses use its conversational AI agents to handle customer inquiries.
Creators can use its tools to narrate a video, create an audiobook or create voices for characters in a podcast. Businesses, meanwhile, can use its technology to handle routine customer service inquiries, translate marketing materials for international audiences or incorporate voice AI into their own software products.
However, realistic AI-generated speech also raises questions about privacy, consent, fraud and the future of voice-related creative work. Understanding the nuances of ElevenLabs’ technology and its policies can help individuals and organizations determine whether it's the right tool for their needs.

## What Is ElevenLabs?
ElevenLabs is a London-based company that develops voice and audio generation technology. It builds AI models that generate natural-sounding speech, recognize spoken language, reproduce voices, translate audio and create other forms of audio content.
The company was founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski, a former Google machine learning engineer, and Mateusz Staniszewski, an ex-Palantir strategist. The Polish co-founders initially set out to improve the quality of film dubbing, which led them to develop the backbone of their audio AI models. The company is best known for developing text-to-speech technology that generates natural-sounding speech, complete with pauses and emotional expression. It has since broadened its offerings to include voice cloning, conversational AI agents, music, sound effects and speech transcription. Its models can now speak, listen and translate in more than 90 languages.
ElevenLabs’ technology was initially popular with creators, but it has become increasingly popular with enterprise customers, which now make up about 55 percent of its roughly $600 million in annual recurring revenue . ElevenLabs’ conversational agents handle more than 15 million conversations per week, disbursing refunds, renewing insurance policies and upgrading phone plans on behalf of the world’s largest tech, insurance and telecom companies. The company announced in September 2026 that it is valued at $22 billion, and it has been reported the company aims to go public in 2028.

## What Are ElevenLabs’ Products?
ElevenLabs’ offerings can be understood through three main product families, each designed for a different type of user or workflow.

## ElevenCreative
ElevenCreative provides no-code tools for generating, editing and localizing audio and visual content. It’s designed primarily for creators, producers, marketing teams and media companies that need to produce content without managing separate tools for every task.
Its capabilities include:
- Text-to-speech: Converts scripts and other written material into spoken audio using a range of different vocal styles, accents and deliveries.

- Voice cloning: Reproduces a user’s voice with AI or generates a new voice based on a written description.

- AI dubbing: Translates audio and video into more than 90 languages.

- Image and video generation: Creates visual assets and videos using integrated generative AI models.

ElevenCreative also includes Studio, a browser-based production workspace that allows users to transform voice, music, sound effects, captions and video into finished assets.

## ElevenAgents
ElevenAgents is a platform for building, deploying and managing conversational AI agents that can provide customer support and other tasks. An AI agent could, for example, answer customer questions, schedule appointments or help process routine service requests, escalating more complex tasks to a human employee.
Businesses can configure agents with instructions, connect them to external tools and software, and establish guardrails to influence how they respond. The company says its agents can handle interruptions, manage conversational turn-taking and ground responses in a knowledge base specific to that company.
ElevenLabs also offers Reception AI, a purpose-built, ready-to-deploy agent that can handle many of the duties of a phone receptionist, such as fielding incoming calls and other routine administrative tasks.

## ElevenAPI
ElevenAPI allows software developers to integrate text-to-speech, transcription and other generative audio capabilities into their own applications via API . This gives developers the technical control, flexibility and customization they need to create a specific software product.
For example, a developer building a language learning app could integrate ElevenLabs’ API to let users listen to vocabulary, lessons and example conversations in natural-sounding voices. The app could also use speech-to-text to transcribe the language learner’s spoken responses. Both features would work directly within the app’s existing interface, with ElevenLabs providing the underlying audio technology through its API.

## What Is ElevenLabs Used For?
ElevenLabs has applications across customer service, content creation, software development and other industries.

## Customer Service and Business Operations
Businesses can deploy conversational AI agents to answer calls, respond to common questions, schedule appointments and help customers navigate routine workflows. These applications can be particularly useful for providing service outside business hours or answering commonly asked questions, freeing up customer service representatives to handle more complex inquiries.

## Video Production and Social Media
Creators can use ElevenLabs to generate narration for YouTube videos, social media posts, advertisements and educational content. Instead of recording every voiceover themselves, they can produce speech from scripts and make revisions by editing text. Creators can also use ElevenLabs’ tools to generate sound effects or translate materials into different languages.

## Audiobooks and Podcasts
Publishers and independent authors can use text-to-speech tools to produce audiobooks at minimal expense. With ElevenReader, the company’s subscription-based audiobook app, users can create narrations for their own documents and access audiobooks read aloud by AI narrators, some of which can be customized to meet the listeners’ preferences. Podcasters can also use ElevenLabs’ tools to transform recorded voices or create localized versions of their shows.

## Software Development
Developers can integrate ElevenLabs’ capabilities into applications using its APIs and software development tools. Developers can use these tools to incorporate voice-enabled interfaces, transcription features and real-time conversational agents into a software application. Rather than building every audio-processing component from scratch, developers can use the company's existing infrastructure and configure it for their needs.

## Music Creation
ElevenLabs is experimenting with a foray into the music world. The company announced in September 2026 that it will partner with Universal Music Group to launch an AI-powered music creation platform, giving fans a way to remix and mashup music from participating artists. The two companies also plan to collaborate in the development of AI audio products for artists.

## Global Communications
Companies producing training materials, marketing videos or educational resources for international audiences can use AI dubbing to create materials in multiple languages without arranging separate recording sessions for every market. Of course, companies should still review the content for accuracy, particularly in situations involving specialized terminology, culturally specific references or legally significant information.

## Accessibility and Voice Restoration
Speech generation tools can provide spoken access to written material for people who are blind or have low vision. AI voice generation can also help people communicate when illness or injury has affected their ability to speak. By synthesizing recordings taken before they lost their voice, these individuals can communicate with a more authentic, personalized voice instead of a generic computer-generated voice.

## Benefits of ElevenLabs
One of ElevenLabs’ biggest advantages is the range of audio-related tasks it supports within a single platform. A creator or business can generate speech, edit voices, transcribe recordings and translate content without necessarily relying on separate providers for every step.
Efficiency is another major benefit. Generating narration from a script can be faster than coordinating recording sessions, especially when a project requires many revisions, multiple speakers or different languages. AI voice agents can also respond to routine business inquiries without requiring a human employee to handle every interaction.
The technology offers considerable flexibility. Users can select an existing voice, create a custom voice or clone a voice with appropriate authorization. Different models are optimized for different needs, including expressive narration and lower-latency conversational applications. This gives creators and developers options for balancing authenticity, speed and cost.

## Concerns About ElevenLabs’ Voice AI
Despites its technological innovation and business benefits, ElevenLabs' voice AI  technology has drawn scrutiny over its potential for fraud and misinformation, its data privacy practices and its impact on working voice actors.

## Fraud and Misinformation
Voice cloning can create an audio recording of someone saying something they never actually said, which could be used to facilitate fraud or spread misinformation.
In 2024, ElevenLabs came under fire when a political consultant cloned then-President Joe Biden’s voice for a robocall campaign that discouraged New Hampshire voters from voting in the presidential primary . The Federal Communications Commission imposed a $6 million fine on the political consultant responsible. ElevenLabs, meanwhile, has restricted clones of certain public figures’ voices and required consent confirmation for voice cloning. It’s also developed an AI Speech Classifier for checking whether audio may have been generated using its technology.
Elected officials have publicly questioned what ElevenLabs and other AI voice companies are doing to prevent scammers from cloning someone’s voice, like a friend or family member, to obtain money or gain access to sensitive information.

## Privacy and Data Handling
By default, ElevenLabs retains voice recordings and other personal data to train its AI models. The company says it does not use data from enterprise customers for AI training, and on some products, it offers a “Zero Retention Mode” that deletes data once the request is completed. The company also gives non-enterprise users the option to opt out of sharing their data for AI training.
Similar to other AI companies, ElevenLabs uses publicly available or third-party information to train its models, which has raised concerns about unauthorized usage. In May 2026, a group of Chicago journalists, podcasters and voice actors sued ElevenLabs and eight other big tech companies for allegedly using their voices to train AI models. Filing their lawsuit in Illinois, which has the strongest biometric privacy laws in the country, the plaintiffs claimed ElevenLabs and other tech companies stole their “voiceprint,” which they say is a mathematical representation of their unique voice.

## Undermining Artists
When actor Michael Caine agreed to have his voice cloned for an audiobook retelling of Homer’s “The Odyssey,” some in the media industry began to wonder if AI audiobooks would become a trend that would undermine the value of working voice actors.
But AI audiobooks haven't reduced the demand for voice actors yet, as many still find actors to be more emotive than even ElevenLabs’ most advanced models. Only 16 percent of audiobook listeners have reported listening to an AI-voiced audiobook, according to an Audio Publishers Association survey , and AI audiobooks made up less than half of a percent of the audiobook industry’s revenue in 2025.

## Is ElevenLabs Safe to Use?
ElevenLabs can be used safely for many legitimate creative and business purposes, but safety depends on how the technology is used and what information users provide.
Perhaps the biggest area of concern is data privacy. ElevenLabs says that the company may retain and train its AI on user data unless users have opted out or are using an enterprise-level subscription. Users should be mindful of these policies, particularly if they are submitting confidential business information or personal details. Businesses handling regulated information should verify that their chosen product and contractual arrangements meet their security and compliance requirements.
